method: Independent bounded synthetic fixture checks and two ordinary-command completion oracles at fixed population/technology. No historical or ongoing campaign state accessed; no campaign cohort. Source rules are unchanged.

checks.name: Forge threshold separates five-cycle investment from two-to-one-cycle frigate throughput
Funds, orders and paid queue block commissioning without blocking structural comparison or leaking planning funds
Missing technology, absent support and full slots cannot invent completed outcomes
Removing Extractor includes the full dependent Extraction charter loss
Removing a shipyard yields unavailable ship comparisons and a reduced repair pool
Removing Forge support removes factory production, charter production, discount and charter repair together
Habitat removal preserves population and infrastructure capacity above the new growth limit
Current research, faction rounding, capped orders and damaged-colony defense use actual yield rules
Local visible blockade is separate from nominal repair; hidden rival fleets/economies do not affect the projection
Ordinary Forge completion consumes five cycles at the old rate and agrees with the fixed-condition projection
Ordinary replacement retains old income through completion and applies new income on the next cycle
Returned nested records are detached and JSON reload reproduces the same comparison
